title: Customize Pattern Annotation | Clo Feature Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Annotation feature in CLO 2025.0 allows you to set the orientation, size, and color of pattern annotations for quick and clear access to pattern information. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

markdown_content: ## Overview of Pattern Annotation Updates in CLO 2025.0 This section introduces the updated annotation features in CLO's 2025.0 release, focusing on how users can add and edit annotations on pattern pieces within the 2D toolbar. Key terms include annotations, pattern pieces, and the property editor. ## Adding Annotations to Patterns Annotations can be added easily using the 2D toolbar in CLO. To add an annotation: - Select the "A" tool in the 2D toolbar. - Click on the desired pattern piece. - Type the annotation text, such as "Sleeve, left, cut one" or "Top, 42." - Press Enter to finalize the annotation. Multiple annotations can be added to different pattern pieces by repeating these steps. ## Editing Annotations with Advanced Controls The 2025.0 update introduces enhanced editing capabilities accessible via the Property Editor: - Open the Property Editor and select the "Edit Annotations" tool, represented by an "A" icon with a cursor. - Select an existing annotation on the pattern. - In the Property Editor, you can modify: - Font size - Color - Angle (align annotations parallel, on the x-axis, or at a custom angle) - Double-clicking an annotation allows direct text editing. ## Annotation Manipulation and Shortcuts Annotations can be manipulated with standard commands: - Rotate annotations by right-clicking and selecting rotation options, including: - Rotate clockwise by 45 degrees - Reset rotation to align with the baseline - Delete annotations via right-click or keyboard shortcuts. - Copy and paste annotations using: - Ctrl + C (copy) - Ctrl + V (paste) For example, after copying an annotation, you can paste it onto another pattern piece and edit its text or color to suit. ## Practical Benefits of Enhanced Annotations These improvements allow users to: - Add detailed information directly onto patterns. - Customize annotation appearance for clarity. - Efficiently manage multiple annotations across pattern pieces. - Streamline communication and documentation through production workflows. This update enhances the annotation tool's flexibility, making it more useful for detailed pattern work and production readiness.
